RemediationStrings.Title: saiife is not installed
RemediationStrings.Description: Install the saiife package so agents on this device are locked. See docs/fleet.md#intune-windows.

RemediationStrings.Title: saiife doctor reports failures
RemediationStrings.Description: Run 'saiife doctor' in an administrator shell on the device and fix the failing checks. See docs/fleet.md#intune-windows.
